projects.title: Apple Stock Price Prediction
projects.description: LSTM deep-learning forecasting pipeline built with TensorFlow and Keras, with an interactive Streamlit deployment for exploring Apple stock predictions.
projects.problem: Forecast future Apple stock prices from historical market trends to support data-driven investment analysis.
projects.solution: End-to-end ML pipeline covering data collection, cleaning, feature engineering and normalization, followed by LSTM model training, prediction, evaluation and an interactive Streamlit interface for exploring forecasts.
projects.outcome: A completed deep-learning project demonstrating the full time-series forecasting workflow — from raw market data to a deployed Streamlit app — aligned to Data Scientist and Python Developer roles.
projects.resumeSummary: Built an LSTM-based Apple stock price prediction system in Python (TensorFlow/Keras) with a Streamlit interface for interactive forecasting.
projects.interviewExplanation: I framed this as a time-series forecasting problem: collect historical Apple prices, clean and normalize the series, engineer lag features, then train an LSTM in TensorFlow/Keras. I evaluate the model on held-out data and expose predictions through a Streamlit app so the workflow is interactive end-to-end. It's the project I use to explain deep learning for sequences and the full data-science lifecycle.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Classification workflow analyzing 7,000+ customer records with Scikit-learn to identify churn patterns and support retention decisions.
projects.problem: Customer teams need a structured way to identify accounts with a higher likelihood of churn and understand the factors associated with attrition.
projects.solution: A Python and Scikit-learn classification pipeline covering data cleaning, feature preparation, model training, comparison, and evaluation across 7,000+ customer records.
projects.outcome: A completed classification project demonstrating the full machine-learning workflow from raw customer records to evaluated churn predictions.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a customer churn classification workflow in Python and Scikit-learn across 7,000+ customer records.
projects.interviewExplanation: I framed this as a classification problem: clean the customer data, prepare model features, compare classification approaches, and evaluate how reliably the model identifies churn patterns.

projects.title: Sales Performance Analysis (SQL)
projects.description: SQL analysis of 50,000+ retail transaction records using 30+ optimized queries across JOINs, CTEs, and window functions.
projects.problem: Retail stakeholders need clear answers about revenue, products, customers, and sales trends hidden across a large transaction dataset.
projects.solution: A structured SQL analysis using more than 30 optimized queries, including JOINs, CTEs, aggregations, and window functions, across 50,000+ retail records.
projects.outcome: A completed SQL portfolio project that turns transaction-level retail data into structured, decision-ready performance findings.
projects.resumeSummary: Analyzed 50,000+ retail transaction records with 30+ optimized SQL queries using JOINs, CTEs, and window functions.
projects.interviewExplanation: I organized the analysis around business questions, then used JOINs, CTEs, aggregations, and window functions to convert transaction-level retail data into clear performance findings.

projects.title: Sales Dashboard (Power BI)
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard built with relational data modeling, Power Query transformations, DAX measures, and key business KPIs.
projects.problem: Business stakeholders need a single, trustworthy view of sales KPIs instead of scattered Excel files and manual reports.
projects.solution: A Power BI report modelled from SQL/Excel sources, with cleaned data, calculated KPIs and interactive visuals for slicing by product, region and period.
features: KPI cards for revenue, orders and growth
Interactive slicers by region, product and period
SQL-sourced data model with cleaned inputs
projects.outcome: A dashboard that turns raw sales data into a decision-ready view — the core deliverable expected of Data Analyst and MIS Analyst roles.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a Power BI sales dashboard on SQL/Excel sources with KPI cards and interactive slicers for business reporting.
projects.interviewExplanation: I treated this like a real reporting request: understand the KPIs stakeholders care about, model the data in Power BI from SQL/Excel sources, and design visuals that answer questions in one click. It's the project I use to talk through the Data Analyst / MIS Analyst workflow end-to-end.
